	ChangeTopbarColor = function(TargetColor3, Transition, ToOriginal)
		local OriginalColor = Color3.fromRGB(26,94,30);
			if ToOriginal == true then TargetColor3 = OriginalColor; end
spawn(function() pcall(function()
		if Transition then Transition = string.lower(Transition) end;
		local FakeTopbarUI = game.Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):FindFirstChild("FakeTopbarUI");
		local Frame = FakeTopbarUI:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Frame");
			if FakeTopbarUI and Frame then
				if Transition == "smooth" then
					local prevRGB = Color3.fromRGB(Frame.BackgroundColor3.r * 255, Frame.BackgroundColor3.g * 255, Frame.BackgroundColor3.b * 255);
					for i = 0,1,0.1 do
						Frame.BackgroundColor3 = prevRGB:Lerp(TargetColor3, i);
						wait()
					end
				else if Transition == "instant" then
					Frame.BackgroundColor3 = TargetColor3
				end
				end
			end
		end) end)
	end
}

return module

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage");
local Modules = RS:WaitForChild("Modules");
local PetsModule = require(Modules:WaitForChild("Pets_module"));
local ShopItems = RS:WaitForChild("ShopItems");
local ShopPets = ShopItems:WaitForChild("Pets");

--//
for i,v in ipairs(PetsModule) do
	for _,b in pairs(ShopPets:GetChildren()) do
		for _,a in pairs(b:GetChildren()) do
			if a.Name == v["Names"] then
				local SaleValue = Instance.new("BoolValue", a);
				SaleValue.Name = "OnSale";
				SaleValue.Value = v["OnSale"];
			end
		end
	end
end
